newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume jump on demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume jump on demand.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange jumped to 992 kilos on fresh demand on Monday from Friday's 205 kilos among steady world prices and dealer expectations of price rises in the near future, dealers said.

"As the dollar was still low compared to last week, demand was quite strong, consisting of traders taking up positions ahead of expected price rises, rather than any real physical demand," one dealer said.
Gold closed at $369.10 an ounce, compared to $368.30 at the end of Thursday's morning session, the last time gold was traded in dollar terms on the exchange.
Gold's lira value remained unmoved at 1,236,000 lira per gram as the Turkish currency weakened against the dollar. The lira ended at 103,980 to the dollar versus Friday's 102,800.
Traded volume was 612 kilos in the morning session and 380 kilos in the afternoon and 76.3 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
